3x-ui SiteKit 0.3.0-rc4 dependency provenance and build recipe
2026-11-23, Linux amd64 target, Ubuntu 26.04 and CPython 3.14 for Certbot.

  identify the exact released bytes independently of regenerating the lists.

Go builds

Extract the two vendored source tars in separate scratch directories. Copy
the supplied final go.mod and go.sum into each tree. For each use Go 1.27.4,
GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOENV=off, GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org,
GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org. Run go mod download and go mod verify.

For the panel, use the supplied npm lock from the upstream commit. Under
frontend/ run npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund, then npm run build.
From the panel source root build:

  CC='zig cc -target x86_64-linux-musl' CXX='zig c++ -target x86_64-linux-musl' \
  CGO_ENABLED=1 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 GOAMD64=v1 \
  go build -p 4 -trimpath -mod=readonly -buildvcs=false \
    -ldflags="-s -w -buildid= -linkmode external -extldflags '-static'" -o x-ui .

From the Xray source root build:

  CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 GOAMD64=v1 \
  go build -p 4 -trimpath -mod=readonly -buildvcs=false \
    -ldflags="-s -w -buildid= -X github.com/xtls/xray-core/core.build=1b1647c" \
    -o xray-linux-amd64 ./main

Both exact Go executable hashes were reproduced in a second build using
GOPROXY=off and the verified module cache. The verified/ folder contains
go version -m and govulncheck 1.10.0 evidence. Rebuild with the target GOOS,
GOARCH and CGO settings before auditing source again.

Certbot runtime build

1. Extract the pinned OpenSSL source and build linux-x86_64 with Zig using
   CC='zig cc -target x86_64-linux-gnu.2.34', AR='zig ar', RANLIB='zig ranlib'.

   ./Configure linux-x86_64 shared no-tests no-docs no-apps \
     --prefix=/opt/https-node/certbot/openssl --openssldir=/etc/ssl --libdir=lib
   make -j4 build_libs
   make install_dev DESTDIR=/absolute/path/to/openssl-stage

2. Extract the pinned cryptography sdist. With Rust 1.97.1 and the Linux GNU
   target installed, run cargo fetch --locked --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.
   Set OPENSSL_DIR, OPENSSL_LIB_DIR and OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR to the staged
   OpenSSL development files. Set OPENSSL_STATIC=0. Point both
   CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_LINKER and CC_x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu
   at a wrapper executing zig cc -target x86_64-linux-gnu.2.34. Use CPython
   3.14 with the stated maturin, cffi and setuptools build versions.
   Set AR_x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu and RANLIB_x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu to
   wrappers for zig ar and zig ranlib.

   PYO3_CROSS=1 PYO3_CROSS_PYTHON_VERSION=3.14 CRATE_CC_NO_DEFAULTS=1 \
   CFLAGS_x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu='-fPIC -O2' SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1795456800 \
   maturin build --release --locked --offline --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
     --compatibility linux --auditwheel skip --interpreter python3.14

3. For the runtime archive use the freshly built libcrypto.so.3 and
   libssl.so.3, the rebuilt wheel and the other PyPI wheels in the final
   requirements.lock. The reference PyPI wheel used for comparison is not
   selected by the runtime. pip 26.3 boots the offline install from its wheel
   and is kept outside the installed venv. No system pip is required.

The lock and hashes under verified/ describe the exact supplied artifact.
The project installer independently verifies the complete release SHA-256
and the nested manifest before starting system installation. Use the manifest
to compare a rebuild before admitting it into a dated policy.

Private nginx OpenSSL runtime

RC4 adds x-ui/nginx-openssl to the pinned RC2 staging archive. The two ELF
libraries are unmodified copies of the reviewed OpenSSL build described
above. At installation the managed nginx and Certbot use independent
copies and absolute paths. The small private nginx directory has its own
SHA256SUMS. Reproduce the RC4 archive with:

  python3 dependencies/repack-nginx-openssl.py \
    HTTPS-Node-0.3.0-rc2-linux-amd64.tar.gz \
    3x-ui-sitekit-0.3.0-rc4-linux-amd64.tar.gz

Pinned RC2 staging archive SHA-256:
  832452bfe1e36e91e89a478f866d93e972a80a9d9306aa40f8b509f0eb8b8a9b
Expected RC4 runtime SHA-256:
  cb2abb5a45b8eee5d30ad0d4e8de6003b088a943ae8f0c2d32af6fec799e787f
The tracked SOURCE-ARCHIVES.sha256 covers archives included in the complete
source release. The GitHub-generated source snapshot omits these assets.
